Guest: Sen. Mark Warner (D-Virginia), ranking Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee.
Quotes: US bases "have been on and off under attack" since the beginning of the Iran war.
"It's remarkable in many ways that we've not had more casualties." (per CBS liveblog, 11:42 AM ET)
Warner characterised the conflict as a "war of choice" and said there was no imminent Iranian threat when it began in February.
Context: his comments responded to the deaths of two American service members at a Jordanian base over the weekend.
Also on the episode: Chris Krebs and David Becker on election security (not Iran).
